content.title: Console Server
content.subtitle: Serial console server for remote out-of-band device access

deleteDevice.title: Remove Console Device
deleteDevice.description: This will remove the console device <mono>{name}</mono> and stop all associated SSH access. This action cannot be undone.

deleteAll.title: Remove All Console Server Configuration
deleteAll.description: This will delete all console server devices and their configurations. All serial console access will stop immediately. This action cannot be undone.
